experiment: Disable only SSAO in a copy of the frozen Aperture final scene.
result: Conspicuous noisy silhouette outlines disappear in the inspected render. AO is causally implicated; individual depth/projection/filtering contributions were not isolated.
sourceFindings: AO viewDepth/viewPosition assumes perspective projection; the scene camera is orthographic.
Generated app passes radius/intensity/power/sampleCount, without camera projection parameters.
AO derives normals from neighboring depth pixels and uses a noisy eight-sample pattern without a denoising pass.
MSAA depth samples are averaged, which can mix surfaces at silhouettes.
Three scene uses GTAO with 24 samples, view-normal MRT, denoising and final FXAA on a non-MSAA scene pass.
